jobs.title: Senior Marine Ecologist, benthic and shellfish ecology
jobs.description:
Your job

As an experienced Senior Marine Ecologist at Wageningen Marine Research (WMR) in Yerseke, you will lead a team of dedicated researchers who are working together on a range of ecologically relevant issues of societal importance in the South-Western Delta.

As a Senior Marine Ecologist, specialized in benthic organisms and shellfish, you will use your knowledge and experience to carry out research in the South-Western Delta. You will lead a team of enthusiastic fellow ecologists with whom you will carry out research focusing on the effects of human activities such as fishing and sand replenishment, and the consequences of climate change on marine benthic fauna. You will contribute to nature conservation through the active restoration of shellfish beds in the North Sea and the Delta. You have an affinity for applied research and working in complex policy and stakeholder environments. You will initiate new research, including securing funding for it, and lead major projects.

Your Duties And Responsibilities Include

to act as a leading figure in the field of benthic ecology in contacts with (potential) clients and the media;
to manage and carry out large-scale and complex research projects;
securing new research and drafting multidisciplinary research proposals;
maintaining and expanding the national and international network in the field of delta- and benthic ecology and the restoration of shellfish beds;
presenting the research findings to the business community, sector organizations, civil society organizations, government bodies and fellow scientists.

Your team

Based at WMR’s site in Yerseke, you will work alongside various project teams of differing compositions. As a project leader, you will provide substantive and project-related guidance to field staff, junior and mid-level researchers, enabling them to carry out their work efficiently and thoroughly.

You will work here

Wageningen Marine Research (https://www.wur.nl/en/research/marine) (WMR) is one of the nine institutes that form part of Wageningen Research. WMR is a leading, independent research institute with sites in Yerseke, IJmuiden and Den Helder, which focuses on strategic and applied marine ecological research. Products and services are delivered on a project basis and are diverse in nature: field research, realistic-scale experiments, exploratory laboratory-scale studies, data management and modelling. The institute has modern research facilities and is ISO 9001 certified.

Your area of work will primarily be the south-western Delta, but other parts of the Netherlands, such as the North Sea and the Wadden Sea, as well as international projects, are also possibilities.

Your qualities

You are proactive, results-oriented and have excellent communication and organizational skills. You are able to maintain an overview of complex processes, work with precision and feel at ease in an environment where different interests and disciplines come together.

You Also Possess

relevant university degree and PhD in Marine Ecology;
extensive work experience as a researcher and project leader in the field of benthic ecology;
entrepreneurial spirit, decisiveness, the ability to take the initiative, good teamwork skills, and a customer- and results-oriented approach;
a good command of the Dutch language is a strong advantage.

In our international working environment there is an increasing amount of communication in English. For this position it is about language level (https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale) B2. If you haven’t yet reached this level, we will of course help you, and you are welcome to visit our language centre, Wageningen in’to Language (https://www.wur.nl/en/education/into-languages).

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross salary of between € 4,938.- and € 7,337.- for a full-time working week of 36 hours, in accordance with the CLA Wageningen Research (scale 12). Additionally, for this role a contract for 24 to 36 hours hours can be discussed. As for your contract, we initially offer a one-year contract that can be extended. Of course, we are happy to have a conversation with you if you have any questions about this.

Wageningen University & Research offers plenty of opportunities for growth and development, with a strong internal recruitment policy and excellent training programmes.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract serves as the starting point; please ask your HR Business Partner about your specific situation. We encourage development and mobility within our organization. Our recruitment and selection policy outlines the specific conditions that apply to you as a (former) employee.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/) can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account, dual career programs or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Jeroen Wijsman, Researcher Marine Ecologist, via phone number: +31 317-487114 or via email: jeroen.wijsman@wur.nl (mailto:jeroen.wijsman@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Get in touch with Dax Teunissen, Corporate Recruiter, via email: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button next to the vacancy on our website. Only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

You can apply up to and including Monday 26 October 2026.
Internal candidates are preferred to apply before 1st October 2026
.

Applications are reviewed regularly. Therefore, the position may be filled before the stated closing date.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

Wageningen Marine Research

Wageningen Marine Research (WMR) is a leading independent research institute with locations in IJmuiden, Den Helder and Yerseke. The institute focuses on strategic and applied marine ecological research. Its products and services are delivered on a project basis, with more than 400 research projects carried out annually, ranging from field studies and full-scale experiments to exploratory laboratory studies, data management and modelling. The institute is equipped with modern research facilities and is ISO 9001 certified. Wageningen Marine Research is organisationally part of Wageningen University & Research. Research within our institute focuses on understanding the spatial and temporal dynamics of individuals, populations, ecosystems and socio-ecological systems. This includes accounting for changing environmental conditions, climate change and human activities in marine and freshwater environments. We work with a wide variety of species, ranging from corals and fish to marine mammals and birds, across both benthic and pelagic ecosystems. In addition, we investigate human behaviour, for example that of fishers. To achieve this, we make use of experimental field and laboratory data, mathematical models and computer simulations.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

Read the 5 reasons (https://www.wur.nl/en/Jobs/Why-choose-WUR.htm) why your future colleagues enjoy working at WUR and watch the video below to get an idea of our green campus!

We will recruit for the vacancy ourselves, so no employment agencies please. However, sharing in your network is appreciated.

jobs.title: LEAD ANDROID / APPLICATION DRONE
jobs.description:
À propos

SkyVisor est une entreprise technologique qui fournit des solutions logicielles aux exploitants de centrales de production d’énergie renouvelable comme les éoliennes et panneaux solaires.

Fondée en 2018, SkyVisor permet à ses clients de digitaliser et d'optimiser la maintenance des infrastructures énergétiques afin de démocratiser la maintenance prédictive.

Grâce à ses solutions qui reposent sur des technologies de rupture comme les drones autonomes ou le machine learning, SkyVisor est devenu en peu de temps un acteur clé de l’inspection des éoliennes et parcs photovoltaïques avec une présence internationale dans plus de 30 pays.

L’entreprise cherche maintenant à accélérer sa croissance à l'international, développer de nouvelles solutions digitales et accroitre ses avancées technologiques.

Descriptif du poste

Acteur reconnu de l'inspection automatisée d'éoliennes et de centrales photovoltaïques par drones, SkyVisor recherche un Lead Android / Application
Drone
pour renforcer son équipe R&D et relever les challenges de croissance de l'entreprise.

Vous souhaitez développer des applications Android de pilotage de drones
en conditions réelles, où chaque évolution est validée aussi bien par des tests automatisés que par des campagnes d'essais sur le terrain ? Vous aimez construire des logiciels robustes, fiables et maintenables, capables de fonctionner dans des environnements exigeants ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous !

En lien direct avec le responsable technique de SkyVisor
et en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Produit et Opérations, vous serez responsable de notre solution drone innovante afin de capturer les données et l'imagerie des infrastructures energétiques renouvelables.

Concrètement Les Missions Consistent à

Prendre le leadership technique de l'application droneApp SkyVisor et faire évoluer son architecture dans une logique de qualité, de robustesse et de pérennité.
Développer les composants logiciels et missions embarquées nécessaires au besoin des nouvelles fonctionnalités de l'application mobile, adapter l'application pour de nouveaux modèles de drones/cameras
Contribuer techniquement aux spécifications et à l'architecture, un apprentissage du métier éolien et solaire sera nécessaire
Définir et mettre en œuvre une véritable stratégie de qualité logicielle : tests unitaires, tests d'intégration, tests instrumentés Android, automatisation des tests et validation continue.
Être garant de la stabilité de l'application, de la gestion des régressions et de la fiabilité des versions livrées.
Organiser très régulièrement des essais terrains sur des éoliennes et parcs solaires (nombreux déplacements à prévoir)
Concevoir des algorithmes de plan de vol du drone et de computer vision (reconnaissance d'objets en temps réel)
Effectuer une veille permanente sur l'industrie afin de proposer des solutions innovantes et pragmatiques

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un ingénieur qui apprécie autant le développement logiciel que la validation sur le terrain. Chez SkyVisor, un développement n'est réellement terminé que lorsqu'il a démontré sa robustesse en conditions réelles.

Vous Aimez

développer des applications Android complexes ;
concevoir des architectures maintenables et évolutives ;
automatiser les tests pour fiabiliser les livraisons ;
comprendre le comportement d'un système complet, de l'implémentation jusqu'au vol du drone ;
confronter vos développements aux essais terrain afin d'améliorer continuellement la qualité du produit.

Profil Recherché

Master, école d'ingénieurs
+3 ans d'expérience dans le développement mobile Android
Vous êtes parfaitement à l'aise avec les environnements et langages associés aux technologies Android: Kotlin, Java, Compose, Android Studio, gradle, git...
Connaissances dans le domaine des drones DJI (MSDK, PSDK), robotique/code embarqué (C/C++), la vision par ordinateur (openCV) ainsi que la photographie seraient un plus mais non obligatoire
Excellente communication verbale et écrite requise (français et anglais)
Approche organisée et professionnelle avec un goût pour les challenges
Rigueur, autonomie et curiosité sont des qualités appréciées
Permis B obligatoire

Parmi Nos Avantages

10 jours de RTT par an en plus des 25 jours de congés légaux
2 jours de télétravail par semaine
Mutuelle
Carte restaurant Swile

Poste basé à Rennes
(proche gare), pas de full remote

Process de recrutement

Visio avec notre CTO
Visio avec notre CEO en anglais
Entretien dans nos locaux à Rennes : tests techniques, échanges avec l'équipe tech, présentation de nos produits

Informations complémentaires

Type de contrat : CDI
Date de début : 01 novembre 2026
Lieu : Rennes
Niveau d'études : Bac +5 / Master
Expérience : > 3 ans
Télétravail partiel possible
Salaire : entre 45000€ et 60000€ / an

jobs.title: Environmental Concept Artist
jobs.description:
BEFORE YOU APPLY:
Please read the compensation information at the bottom of the page!

OVERVIEW

We are currently looking for concept artists for our ongoing comic book development that we are running similarly to a TV show/movie (Art Directors, Producers, Concept Art before “shooting it” (pencilling, inking etc.)).

ABOUT THE COMPANY

We are creating films, games, and comics - stories with soul - for our own fantasy universe (think Lord of the Rings, Star Wars, etc., but smaller - for now hehe). We started 4 years ago as a small team of folks who were initially supposed to package a TV show. Finding ourselves unwilling to sign away our IP, we decided to build out the universe ourselves to retain (creative) control. Now, 4 years later, our rag-tag band of pirates has grown to over 150 members (far over 200 depending on how you count).
Our current slate includes 3 short films (2 in active development, 1 in post production, 30min each), a comic book series (9 issues of Season 1, 45 pages/issue), and two games (one Card Game online and offline version featuring our characters and factions, and one TTRPG with one shots, campaign rules, and region expansions). We also produce music, art, and have our own in-house media marketing element and ops.
We have been working on getting greenlight, production up, worldbuilding ready, and marketing infrastructure set up. Now our task is mostly about improving the existing processes and bringing us into our first launches with financial implications (thus far, we took on some investment but have not made revenue yet - you first have to make a film to make box office).

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Create concepts within a team for various projects, working under the guidance of the Worldbuilding team and Advisors
Gather references and create mood boards to convey ideas prior to design execution
Conduct research to understand the complexity of concepts in order to design them believably
Work comfortably in a grounded, realistic fantasy art style
Create concept art for characters, creatures, environments, and props
Work from structured briefs with worldbuilding and creative leadership

YOU

Proactive attitude toward skill development and growth
Experienced in background or environment design
Transparent and responsive communication
Professional working proficiency in English
Ability to adapt artistic style to the project’s aesthetic
Strong grasp of artistic fundamentals, including color, composition, value, form, anatomy, brushwork, and perspective
Bonus: Knowledge of 3D software for blockouts

COMPENSATION DETAILS

Time Investment:
Part-time. Approximately 5-15 hours/week (flexible week on week, as we understand you may have other commitments) - you set your own boundaries and communicate your availability.

Salary :
At this point, there is no salary for anyone in our team (from the CEO to the producers to the set runner, nobody draws a salary). We instead give parts of the profit away:

Profit Participation:
We are currently in the development of a profit share/royalty system that will award everyone who is part of the project a piece of the pie without causing any upfront taxation. Upon request for an interview, we will send you a detailed breakdown so you can make a decision on whether or not you want to continue with the application. This is fundamentally an investment contract (time invested, profit participation/royalties gained), and as a result, we are happy to support any due diligence you want to undergo ahead of joining.
Thank you very much for considering the collaboration.
We hope to see you on the other side and that we grow together on these exciting projects!

All the best,
Your Soul Atlas Team

Wageningen Marine Research (WMR) is a leading independent research institute with locations in IJmuiden, Den Helder and Yerseke. The institute focuses on strategic and applied marine ecological research. Its products and services are delivered on a project basis, with more than 400 research projects carried out annually, ranging from field studies and full-scale experiments to exploratory laboratory studies, data management and modelling. The institute is equipped with modern research facilities and is ISO 9001 certified. Wageningen Marine Research is organisationally part of Wageningen University & Research. Research within our institute focuses on understanding the spatial and temporal dynamics of individuals, populations, ecosystems and socio-ecological systems. This includes accounting for changing environmental conditions, climate change and human activities in marine and freshwater environments. We work with a wide variety of species, ranging from corals and fish to marine mammals and birds, across both benthic and pelagic ecosystems. In addition, we investigate human behaviour, for example that of fishers. To achieve this, we make use of experimental field and laboratory data, mathematical models and computer simulations.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

BEFORE YOU APPLY:
Please read the compensation information at the bottom of the page!

OVERVIEW

We are currently looking for concept artists for our ongoing comic book development that we are running similarly to a TV show/movie (Art Directors, Producers, Concept Art before “shooting it” (pencilling, inking etc.)).

ABOUT THE COMPANY

We are creating films, games, and comics - stories with soul - for our own fantasy universe (think Lord of the Rings, Star Wars, etc., but smaller - for now hehe). We started 4 years ago as a small team of folks who were initially supposed to package a TV show. Finding ourselves unwilling to sign away our IP, we decided to build out the universe ourselves to retain (creative) control. Now, 4 years later, our rag-tag band of pirates has grown to over 150 members (far over 200 depending on how you count).
Our current slate includes 3 short films (2 in active development, 1 in post production, 30min each), a comic book series (9 issues of Season 1, 45 pages/issue), and two games (one Card Game online and offline version featuring our characters and factions, and one TTRPG with one shots, campaign rules, and region expansions). We also produce music, art, and have our own in-house media marketing element and ops.
We have been working on getting greenlight, production up, worldbuilding ready, and marketing infrastructure set up. Now our task is mostly about improving the existing processes and bringing us into our first launches with financial implications (thus far, we took on some investment but have not made revenue yet - you first have to make a film to make box office).

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Create concepts within a team for various projects, working under the guidance of the Worldbuilding team and Advisors
Gather references and create mood boards to convey ideas prior to design execution
Conduct research to understand the complexity of concepts in order to design them believably
Work comfortably in a grounded, realistic fantasy art style
Create concept art for characters, creatures, environments, and props
Work from structured briefs with worldbuilding and creative leadership

YOU

Proactive attitude toward skill development and growth
Experienced in background or environment design
Transparent and responsive communication
Professional working proficiency in English
Ability to adapt artistic style to the project’s aesthetic
Strong grasp of artistic fundamentals, including color, composition, value, form, anatomy, brushwork, and perspective
Bonus: Knowledge of 3D software for blockouts

COMPENSATION DETAILS

Time Investment:
Part-time. Approximately 5-15 hours/week (flexible week on week, as we understand you may have other commitments) - you set your own boundaries and communicate your availability.

Salary :
At this point, there is no salary for anyone in our team (from the CEO to the producers to the set runner, nobody draws a salary). We instead give parts of the profit away:

Profit Participation:
We are currently in the development of a profit share/royalty system that will award everyone who is part of the project a piece of the pie without causing any upfront taxation. Upon request for an interview, we will send you a detailed breakdown so you can make a decision on whether or not you want to continue with the application. This is fundamentally an investment contract (time invested, profit participation/royalties gained), and as a result, we are happy to support any due diligence you want to undergo ahead of joining.
Thank you very much for considering the collaboration.
We hope to see you on the other side and that we grow together on these exciting projects!

All the best,
Your Soul Atlas Team
